sections.overview: This parrot is endemic to New Guinea.
sections.identification: It is mostly black and grey with red underparts and a bare face.
sections.habitat: It inhabits hill and lower montane forest, and nearby lowland forest.
sections.diet: It specializes in the pulp of a few fig species.
sections.behavior: It may move seasonally in search of fruit.
sections.reproduction: It nests in large hollow trees and lays one or two eggs.
sections.ecology: Its reliance on a few fig species links its feeding ecology closely to fruit availability.
sections.conservation: The 2017 global IUCN assessment classified it as Vulnerable; hunting for feathers is a major pressure.
